subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

No one even thought that Sheila’s success would __burst the bubble.__
solution:
The correct answer is: Suddenly end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"burst the bubble"** means to bring an end to a period of excitement or happiness, often unexpectedly. (खुशी या उत्तेजना की अवधि को अचानक समाप्त करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The news of the company's bankruptcy **burst the bubble** of the employees who were expecting promotions.
 
 
 
• **"Suddenly end"** refers to an abrupt or unexpected conclusion. (अचानक समाप्त होना)
 
 
• **Example:** The concert **suddenly ended** when the power went out.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Change her into arrogance** (उसे अहंकार में बदल देना): To become conceited or overconfident.

 
 
• **Example:** Her sudden fame **changed her into arrogance**, and she started ignoring her old friends.
 
 
 
• **Break the border** (सीमा को तोड़ना): To cross or violate a boundary.
 
 
• **Example:** The rebels planned to **break the border** and enter the neighbouring country.
 
 
 
• **Last for ever** (हमेशा के लिए रहना): To continue indefinitely or for a very long time.
 
 
• **Example:** Their friendship seemed like it would **last for ever**.
